t: This is 56 Redington Road, a building in Camden, and it was designed by C. H. B. Quennell, just like its neighbour at number 54. Quennell lived from 1872 to 1935 and worked as an architect, designer, illustrator and historian. The heritage architect Cath Layton says his influence can be felt in the houses and streets of London's suburbs and across the country. Have a look at the house and think of it as part of that wider suburban legacy. His books for young people also helped spark interest in history.
